collection.title: BMW ix3 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW ix3 2021 Onwards requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this BMW ix3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
